test_Features_round_trip: test the Features class to_dict and from_dict round-trip serialization for simple, custom, and nested feature schemas
test_ClassLabel_operations: test the ClassLabel class initialization, str2int, int2str, and cast_storage methods with names, names_file, and num_classes
test_cast_to_python_objects: test the cast_to_python_objects function converting nested dicts, lists, numpy arrays, pandas Series, DataFrames, torch tensors, tensorflow tensors, and jax arrays to native Python objects
test_Features_alignment: test the _align_features and _check_if_features_can_be_aligned functions to align nested feature schemas with null types and reordered fields
test_Features_flatten: test the Features.flatten method to flatten nested feature dictionaries into dot-separated column names while preserving List and LargeList structures
